THP-1 MTT cytotoxicity is reported in prose with approximate viability/death context and data not shown, so no CC50/HC50 endpoint was fabricated.
Wound model figures support qualitative/dose/significance context, but exact bar values were not digitized from local images.
The paper discusses membrane-active AMP context but does not run a direct membrane-disruption or molecular-target assay for these centrocin-derived peptides.
